annotations.title: Database Connection Pool Sizing & Concurrency Headroom Calculator

description: Calculates optimal connection pool sizing, idle timeouts, and client headroom based on server RAM and concurrency profile. Use when sizing PgBouncer, HikariCP, or Prisma connection pools to avoid server out-of-memory crashes; for checking transaction isolation hazards, use audit_transaction_isolation instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'server_ram_mb' and 'max_concurrent_clients' ('workload_profile' defaults to 'high_concurrency_oltp'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

max_concurrent_clients.description: Peak anticipated concurrent client connections or serverless worker threads.

server_ram_mb.description: Total available RAM in megabytes dedicated to the database server instance.

workload_profile.description: Workload operational characteristics: high-concurrency OLTP, heavy analytical OLAP, or serverless edge burst.

name: calculate_pool_headroom

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for calculate_pool_headroom.

connection_timeout_ms.description: Recommended pool connection acquisition timeout in milliseconds.

memory_headroom_mb.description: Estimated unallocated memory buffer in megabytes remaining for query sorting.

recommended_max_connections.description: Calculated optimal max pool size to avoid database thrashing and memory exhaustion.

recommended_min_idle.description: Recommended standby idle connection count for warm latency response.

title: Database Connection Pool Sizing & Concurrency Headroom Calculator
